entities.summary: Airliners.net is an aviation website that includes an extensive photo database of aircraft and airports, as well as a forum catering to aviation enthusiasts. Founded by Johan Lundgren, Jr. in Sweden, the site originated in 1996 as Pictures of Modern Airliners. It was acquired by the US company Demand Media in 2007, and underwent a major redesign in 2016.
